maya: Heads-up — seeing a jump in cache staleness for eu-west on model-mix-2b. Prefetch hit % dropped fast in the last 90m.
sam: Can you paste the dashboard panel or a snapshot? Which route is affected?
maya: Panel id 314. Route is /v1/chat/stream. staleness went from ~3% to ~21% between 01:10–02:40 UTC.
li: Any recent deploys or config changes? Could be kernel selection or batching heuristics.
chris: We did deploy runtime-3.2 last night (kernel selection tweaks + metadata salt for prefix keys). tagging @sam in case rollout overlaps.
maya: Per-tenant slice looks noisy — some customers preserved hits, others lost almost all prefix matches.
maya: SQL I ran for per-customer hit-rate (sample):
```
SELECT customer_id, route, model, sum(hit_tokens)/sum(total_tokens) as hit_rate
FROM telemetry.prefix_cache
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY hit_rate ASC
LIMIT 50;
```
li: Prom query to view token-saved delta by model/route:
```
sum by(model, route) (increase(prefix_cache_saved_tokens[2h]))
/ sum by(model, route) (increase(tokens_consumed[2h]))
```
sam: If this ties to the salt change it's likely key mismatch (effective keyspace shift). Quick mitigation: flip salt off for canary to see if hit-rate recovers.
chris: I rolled `runtime.prefetch.key_salt` to false on canary (canary-2) at 02:55 UTC. Watching panel.
maya: After flip, prefix hit-rate on canary recovered to ~18% -> ~52% within 8m. non-canary remains low.
li: That strongly implicates the salt change. We need a migration strategy: either stable re-hash or backwards-compatible key varianting.
sam: Action items: 1) Chris to revert salt in prod rollout and patch hashing for stable keys (owner: chris) 2) Li to run a canary-wide rekeying plan + eval (owner: li) 3) Maya to add heatmap panel per-customer to detect these regressions earlier (owner: maya).
chris: I'll open a PR to add a rollout flag and an automated rekeying job. Will also add a dashboard annotation when salt changes.
maya: Also suggest an alert on "cache_staleness" (golden signal) with a per-model / per-route dimension, not just global. We almost missed customer divergence.
sam: +1. Add a 10m window and a relative delta threshold (e.g., 15 percentage points drop vs baseline).
reliability-bot: [02:40 UTC] Alert triggered: cache_staleness > 0.15 for /v1/chat/stream (eu-west) — severity: medium. Autoresolve when below threshold for 10m.
reliability-bot: [03:10 UTC] Alert resolved: cache_staleness returned below threshold on canary slices.
maya: Thanks all. Will follow up with a short postmortem and link to the PR/boards. :thumbsup:
